category_title: Preschoolers exhibiting inappropriate social behaviors like yelling and taking toys
minimal_context: Gregory is participating in free play time in the preschool classroom and needs to interact appropriately with his peers.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for free play in the classroom. Please find a toy to play with.

STUDENT: (Takes a toy from another child) I want this one!

TUTOR: Let's do a brief rehearsal of our classroom rules.

STUDENT: (Hides the toy behind his back) No!

TUTOR: We need to practice listening to others and being a team player.

STUDENT: (Yells at the other child and starts crying) Go away!

options.A: Allow the student to pick from a choice board of special activities to do in the last 10 minutes of the school day (e.g., helping Mr. Hughes).
options.B: Support the student through shared power by compromising, negotiating situations, or sharing decisions instead of imposing control over behaviors during every daily routine.
options.C: Provide no direct intervention for the student's challenging behaviors during free play and other daily classroom routines in the preschool classroom.
options.D: Provide a clear beginning and end for each classroom task or routine throughout the student's daily schedule in the preschool classroom.
